## Objective

What outcome should this issue produce?

## Context and evidence

What current repository/runtime evidence and accepted decisions govern the work?

## Scope

What is included?

## Non-goals

What adjacent work is explicitly excluded?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The exact expected outcome is stated and verifiable.
- [ ] Validation/evidence requirements are defined.
- [ ] Security, authority, reliability and cost implications are addressed when material.
- [ ] Any fresh independent review requirement is stated.

## Authority boundaries

Identify any action that requires explicit human approval, fresh review, elevated permission, production/destructive authority or material cost commitment. Do not list routine mechanically decidable steps as approval gates.
